statement: A refused terminal transition keeps a retry owner and becomes loud: OperationWorkflowTransitionPersistence.completeOperation/failOperation stop clearing terminal retry state at entry (clearing becomes a consequence of a proven committed terminal, never a precondition of attempting one), the committed:false REFUSED/REINSERTED/null dispositions arm the EXISTING operation-workflow-terminal-transition-repair (today reachable only from the afterCommit confirm path, leaving 'refused' — a strictly worse state than 'committed but invisible' — uncovered) with one typed warn, and completeOperation/failOperation return their typed transitionOutcome so the recovery drain stops reporting progressed:true unconditionally — giving the existing bounded-escalation family its missing terminalization-refused counter. Verified at HEAD d75b01706 across four red formation runs (ec-q6-20260810T09*): the coordinator decides to terminalize 175-249 times per run with ZERO 'Operation completed' lines and zero logging — completeOperation's first statement clearTerminalOperationRetryState kills the armed executor-outcome retry timer (silencing the visibility-deferral loop mid-backoff, timestamped to the ms), the terminal UPDATE returns disposition REFUSED silently via resolveZeroChangeOperationUpdate, and the drain returns true unconditionally after a void completeOperation so level-triggered machinery believes progress. Fail-closed floor: release-gated dispositions (TERMINAL_ADOPTED, IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY) keep today's behavior; no new timers (the repair's 0.5s-30s backoff exists); the raft-level root (stale-log leader election on replica_operations-p1) is explicitly OUT of this quest's scope and routed separately.
